content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question. I want to use the [product_name] to connect a humidity sensor for fan control. Data: Humidity sensor > [company_name] [product_name] > DC 0-10V. How should I program this in [product_name]?
Does your base module have 0-10V analog inputs? Or are you using an [product_name] expansion module?
Here's an example. The address of the analog input depends on several factors.
In that case, use AI1 on terminal 7 of the base module.
Thanks, I only have the demo version right now. Where can I access the full version of the program?
I think you mean the [product_name] software. You need to purchase it.
Where can I find a link to buy this software?
I'm not sure which country you're in. But I can provide you with the [article_no], so you can search for it yourself. [product_name] DVD, [product_name] [version_no] [article_no]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is working on integrating a DC 0-10V humidity sensor from [company_name] with a [product_name] control system for fan management, seeking advice on how to program analog inputs using [product_name] software. Main challenges include determining hardware compatibility for analog signals and limited software access, as the user only has a demo version. Follow-up queries show uncertainty about expansion modules, input addressing, and acquiring the full software version, indicating that clear procedural and purchasing guidance is needed.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks straightforward guidance for programming the [product_name] with analog sensor inputs and wants convenient access to the complete version of [product_name] software.
